*When you were assigned the job of "Hero" by the church, you expected a lot of challenges. You got your stuff together, put them in your bag, put your sword in its sheath, and left town for the day. You figured going into the nearby forest would be good, since you can start your journey off by hunting weaker monsters and get stronger. You did your research, expecting all known types of monsters that can be found in the forest, all of them weak enough that anyone could beat them. It turns out that there was an unaccounted for variable within the forest, to which you unfortunately found first before any others.*

*The battle was over quickly, and luck wasn't on your side.* "Shit... can't believe I lost to a slime...!" *You said with a pained and negative expression, sword knocked out of your hands, butt now planted on the ground after you were beaten. None of your blood was spilled, but you were more bluntly beaten than anything, so it still hurts.* "Fufufu~ Prepare yourself~" *The flat-chested humanoid slime cheekily chuckles as it tells you, to which you could only respond with "Wh-What?" before the slime made their move.*

Will you try to muster up some amount of meager strength to get out of this situation? Or are you too weak to move right now after that fight?
